acceptance_criteria: AC-1: read the full backlog note, docs/history/phase/OP_0B_0_VENDOR_FAILOVER_PREFLIGHT_EVIDENCE_SURFACE.md section 26 (the PAN-15 gap this closes), and the actual PAN identity-evidence code path (find it -- likely under configuration/ or utils/, follow the same producer chain pattern used for the CP identity evidence) to establish, from source, exactly how self_identity_consistent and runtime_peer_serial_state are computed and compared.

AC-2: locate the actual persisted evidence from the S0 real-PAN-pair run referenced in the backlog note (evidence store / build_history / any run_ref it points to) and re-derive the MATCH/MISMATCH computation from that raw evidence by hand (or with a small script) to confirm the recorded finding is reproducible from what was actually captured -- this is the evidentiary basis for everything else in this movement.

AC-3: rule in or out, with source-code and evidence-based reasoning (not speculation): representation divergence (e.g. different serial string formatting between the two members' own self-report vs peer-report fields), a genuine runtime identity discrepancy (the devices actually disagree), or another semantic mismatch class you identify from the actual data.

AC-4: explicitly address the 2026-09-04 update's tension -- the manually-captured `show high-availability all` output reportedly showed reciprocal serial correspondence, apparently contradicting the original MISMATCH. Explain, from the code and evidence, whether this is consistent with your root-cause finding or remains unreconciled, and say which.
AC-5: if a real root cause is found, propose (but do not implement without Product Owner approval, since this touches identity-evidence gate semantics) a closure fix direction with its own tradeoffs.

AC-6: if the root cause cannot be determined from already-persisted evidence and source code alone, say so plainly, name exactly what additional real-device evidence capture would resolve it, and leave a RELAY_NOTE marking this AWAITING_PO with that specific question -- the Product Owner is offline overnight and will review in the morning. Do not attempt a live PAN device run yourself; per AI_START_HERE.md's Real-environment procedure, at most propose the bounded command for the Product Owner to run later.

entries.subject: PAN serial mismatch investigation: inconclusive, needs PO decision on follow-up capture
entries.text: Findings landed: PR #141 (merged, docs/design/PAN_SERIAL_REPRESENTATION_IDENTITY_EVIDENCE_CLOSURE.md + project/backlog.json note update). Root cause NOT conclusively determined from source code + already-persisted evidence (no raw S0 field data was ever persisted anywhere reachable -- only the narrative MATCH/MISMATCH conclusion). Ruled out: representation-divergence parsing bugs in this codebase (whitespace/numeric-conversion re-confirmed clean). Found but not causal for this S0 result: self_identity_consistent/runtime_peer_serial_state compare against I1 (Panorama discovery serial) rather than I2 as the code's own naming and the frozen OP.0b.0 identity contract both imply -- a real naming/contract-vs-implementation gap, separately fixable, does not explain the asymmetry since I1==I2 held for both members per the original note. Leading hypothesis (not proven): a genuine member-B-specific irregularity or an unconfirmed vendor semantic (D-V3a stays STILL_UNKNOWN in the frozen OP.0b.0 contract), supported by two independent pre-existing real anomalies on the same physical member (PAN-3 HA1 config/runtime inconsistency, PAN-12 peer-info completeness). The 2026-09-04 manual show-high-availability-all observation remains unreconciled (different command, no provenance stamp, different time) -- not treated as resolving the original MISMATCH finding, which stands as recorded. QUESTION FOR PO: authorize the one bounded read-only capture proposed in the findings doc -- 'py main.py --only pan-config --pan-config-targets <serial_A>,<serial_B> --pan-ha-peer-diagnostic' against the two already-approved real PAN pair devices -- and separately decide whether to authorize a small additive instrumentation change first (persist which pairwise relationship, I1-vs-I2 / I1-vs-I3 / I2-vs-I3, actually breaks for member B, still booleans only, never raw values) so a second run is diagnosable instead of reproducing the same evidence gap. No identifier normalization performed or recommended either way.
